opening.argument: The video pairs a claimed 7X result with concrete instructions for viewers to fund and execute the process. The speaker reports, “A little over $200 to $1,496. I just did a 7X,” while the description directs viewers to “Send $200 of MATIC to the contract for gas fee for all swaps” and “Call 'flashloan' function in Remix.” That creates a direct funding and participation flow tied to the promoted crypto arbitrage process. The risk warning and qualification that “It probably won't work forever. Someone will shut it down.” may limit what can be inferred about reliability or losses, but they do not remove the combination of a high-return claim and instructions to provide funds and call the contract.
